data.title: Making 'raw:: html' a replacement produces different html
data.body:
I wanted a way to insert html comments in the sphinx-generated output. I.e. ... `` `Other stuff` `` I tried first with: `.. raw:: html` `` which works fine. However, when I turn this into a replacement (for convenience) I get the comment line embedded in `

`'s. I also tried doing it as a role, e.g. `.. role:: raw-custom(raw)` ` :format: html` but this just wraps my comment text in a `` with the class name of the role. Any idea why making the basic raw directive into a replacement changes the output html? MWE attached. [test.zip](https://github.com/sphinx-doc/sphinx/files/335272/test.zip)

data.title: Making 'raw:: html' a replacement produces different html
data.body:
As a standard reST way, the substitution is good for this case.
```
.. |comment| raw:: html

   <!-- comment -->

Hello |comment| world!
```

But it seems ugly a bit. so I just made an extension for such a case.
https://gist.github.com/tk0miya/88901de09906f5f8a9fb8b729a4ff3ab

This extension adds `:raw:html` role. So you can do it with following notation:
```
Hello :raw:html:`<!-- comment -->` world!
```

It works fine for simple cases. Please check this out :-)

Thanks, I'll give it a try. In my company extensions cause headaches as each build platform and user (20+) have to install them and keep them up-to-date. We prefer to keep the list of dependencies as small as possible, impossible as that seems to be.
But my real question was why a replacement produces different output html to the 'replaced' version. I expected a replacement to be a literal drop-in and produce identical output.
